mcqs.learning_point: Effect of excessive consumption of particular foods
mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about eating too much of a particular food is NOT true?

options.A: Consuming too many sugary drinks can lead to weight gain and tooth decay.
options.B: Eating excessive amounts of fried foods can increase the risk of heart disease.
options.C: Eating a lot of carrots will make you see in the dark.
options.D: Eating too much salty food can raise blood pressure.

mcqs.answer: Eating a lot of carrots will make you see in the dark.
mcqs.explanation: Carrots are rich in vitamin A, which is good for eye health, but they do not give night‑vision abilities. The other statements are true: excess sugar, fried foods, and salt each have harmful health effects when consumed in large amounts.

mcqs.question: Sam wants a snack that will give him steady energy and support his growth. Which option should he choose?

options.A: A candy bar that is high in sugar.
options.B: A bowl of mixed fruit with a handful of nuts.

mcqs.answer: A bowl of mixed fruit with a handful of nuts.
mcqs.explanation: Mixed fruit provides natural sugars, vitamins, and fiber for steady energy, while nuts supply protein and healthy fats needed for growth. The other choices are high in added sugars, unhealthy fats, or provide little nutritional value.

mcqs.question: Which pair of statements best describes a balanced diet?

options.A: Eating only vegetables every day; Avoiding all fats.
options.B: Including foods from all food groups in appropriate portions; Providing the body with all essential nutrients.
options.C: Eating large amounts of protein and no carbs; Skipping meals to reduce calories.
options.D: Drinking only fruit juices; Eating fast food regularly.

mcqs.answer: Including foods from all food groups in appropriate portions; Providing the body with all essential nutrients.
mcqs.explanation: A balanced diet means consuming a variety of foods—fruits, vegetables, grains, protein, and dairy—in the right amounts so the body receives all essential nutrients. The other options describe extreme or unhealthy eating patterns.

mcqs.learning_point: Need for different nutrients in suitable amounts
mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly matches a nutrient with its primary function and the amount needed in a typical balanced diet?

options.A: Carbohydrates – provide energy; needed in relatively large amounts.
options.B: Proteins – build muscles; needed in very small amounts.
options.C: Fats – give insulation; needed in excessive amounts.
options.D: Vitamins – supply calories; needed in large amounts.

mcqs.answer: Carbohydrates – provide energy; needed in relatively large amounts.
mcqs.explanation: Carbohydrates are the main source of energy and should constitute the largest portion of daily calories (about 45‑65%). Proteins are needed for growth and repair but in moderate amounts, fats are essential but should be limited, and vitamins are required in tiny amounts and do not provide calories. Hence option A is correct.
